limitations: All eight processes retained per cell, member and source. Process indices are not paired across different runs.
Cross-build absolute changes are descriptive, not same-object randomized causal effects. Original arena timings and fixed-call replay timings remain separate.
coefficient-position is contaminated and remains exploratory only; its contradictory direction is not valid counterevidence requiring a production policy.

The indexed-loop code change is confined to FourStep. Stockham absolute changes cannot be attributed to executing that loop. Code/caller/allocator placement and timing calibration remain context changes.
risks: N210 OOP Estimate mean-p1 is approximately canonical, but median-process p1 remains4.59% slower and sample-median summaries are not uniformly better.
N4096 inverseOOP process1 is persistently slow for both members and all positions. It is retained and still raises the all-process mean relative to canonical.

N210 IP process7 Measure chooses small14x15 and is slower than Estimate in original arena timings. This is an outer-runner observation, not proof of a selector raw-promotion violation; next focus must audit promotion traces.
FourStep frames grew despite fewer iterator operations; larger/multipass and grouped51-cell coverage remains necessary.

condition_semantics.N4096: 0 original;1 PhaseB-only1024;2 all-coefficient1024. Same objects/buffers/calls, reversible conditions.
condition_semantics.N210: All conditions retain original offsets; labels index repeated code-control phases, not actual relocations.

next_candidate.default_change: Keep generic count-indexed FourStep complete(); canonical storage and rectangular anchor unchanged; original zero displacement. Tuning relocation hooks stay inactive in default build.
next_candidate.protocol: Freeze and build a fresh default candidate; run existing correctness/code checks and fresh quiet positive controls, then unchanged51 focus. Preserve every process, absolute best/p1/median, recipes, and raw promotion evidence.
next_candidate.absolute_review: Compare to both canonical-storage and preceding fourstep-storage-anchor default focus, not just diagnostic best. Explicitly revisit N210IP/OOP, N4096OOP/IP, f64N48, f32N80/N96 and larger FourStep/grouped cases.
next_candidate.advance_condition: Full710 only after primary strict2% rule, raw-promotion audit and absolute review all support advancement. No new absolute threshold and no waiver by good M/E.
next_candidate.why_not_more_shifts: Valid current same-object measurements show no attractive PhaseB/all1024 compromise; further offsets would optimize a diagnostic executable context with uncertain default transfer rather than resolve next production gate.
